ns2:section.sectionText: 496 DC: Astro 2010: The Astronomy and Astrophysics Decadal Survey Class will read selected white papers and conclusions for the astronomy and astrophysics decadal survey, discuss what the report reveals about where the greatest opportunities are in astronomical research over the next decade, and discuss implications of priorities set by the report. Students will practice oral presentation skills by giving brief talks introducing a paper. Homework will consist of brief written summaries and reactions to some of the papers.
